text:
Me: I will go to sleep early tonight
Also me at 3 AM: researching the history of soup

Me: I only need one thing from the store
Also me: walking out with a new hobby and zero groceries

Things that hit different at this time of day
Checking your bank account after buying a single coffee
Instant emotional damage

me watching a ten minute youtube tutorial
on how to fix something
that takes three seconds
to ignore forever

Things that hit different at this time of day
peeking at the one macro spreadsheet keeping an entire global corporation alive
and noticing it was built in 2011 by an intern named dave who left no notes

Expectation: We will all contribute equally to the presentation
Reality: Four slides about font choices and zero actual information

Nobody:

Absolutely nobody:

Recipe blogs: I grew up harvesting saffron on a misty cliffside in ancient Greece before my grandmother whispered this soup secret to me

friend: sends a dramatic paragraph in the group chat
everyone: leaves it on read for four hours
someone: replies with a single thumbs up emoji

My brain: pack light, you only need three shirts
Me: stuffing a week-long wardrobe and three extra pairs of shoes into a carry-on just in case

Expectation: I will calmly collect my free holiday cup
Reality: Sprinting three blocks because someone dropped a red paper on the sidewalk

indoor temperature drops by one degree

me wrapping myself in three blankets and a duvet

while refusing to touch the thermostat

My brain: just pick one grocery cart that rolls normally
Me: choosing the one with three functional wheels and a personal vendetta against going straight

watching a random cargo plane over the ocean at 2 am
and suddenly feeling deeply invested
in whether it lands safely in kazakhstan

Expectation: I will simply use my high beams responsibly on dark roads
Reality: Getting flash-banged by the sun because a modern sedan is approaching

POV: you are just trying to drive home at night
and a standard hatchback behind you
is illuminating the entire lunar surface

POV: you are going through airport security
and you suddenly start questioning
if you accidentally packed illegal weapons
though you only own sweatpants

Nobody:
Absolutely nobody:
Me staring at four random words for 20 minutes:
These are definitely synonyms for screaming

me: leaving the group chat on read for four days
also me: feeling personally betrayed
when no one checks if i died

Things that hit different at this time of day:
Checking your phone during a massive outage
and realizing you actually have to look
at the cereal box ingredients

My brain: just do a quick twenty minute focus sprint
Me: spending eighteen minutes setting up a glowing aesthetic timer app

that one friend in the group chat
who reads the entire terms and conditions
before clicking accept
like they are about to negotiate with a medieval goblin

Nobody:
Absolutely nobody:
Me walking across a parking lot:
Wondering if that silent car is about to run me over

that one item you panic bought at a charity shop
for three pounds
because you felt guilty making eye contact
and now it lives in your trunk

Nobody:
Absolutely nobody:
Me sitting in a virtual queue for three hours:
Wondering why I am voluntarily paying to stress

me inspecting every single cracker in the box
after reading one headline about a random factory glitch
like I am a state forensic inspector

Nobody:
Absolutely nobody:
Me voting for a random celebrity on an app at midnight
like my single click is saving the ecosystem

Expectation: tapping your travel card smoothly and walking away like a secret agent
Reality: holding up the entire morning commute while the gate stares at you in silence

Watching the delivery person on the camera app
like a stealth operative
waiting for them to clear the driveway

Expectation: watching a quiet indie drama to relax
Reality: pausing every three minutes to look up the director's childhood trauma on Wikipedia

Nobody:
Absolutely nobody:
Me watching a movie:
Pausing to check if that random background extra was in a 2004 sitcom

Nobody:
Absolutely nobody:
Me tracking down the exact filming location of a random alleyway in a bad 2005 thriller

POV: checking the weather app for a city three time zones away
just to feel something
while sitting in your exact same room
